additional_info.subject: Charger in Failsafe mode
additional_info.body: Charger is online on OCPP & SCB, but it is in Failsafe mode.

additional_info.subject: Analysis [Refer files under Tab Attachments]
additional_info.body:
Failsafe Mode active
Last booted on 2025-05-02T14:54:04 with verison v6.0.3
Last BootNotification BootNotification (762aeb00-36b2-40c3-a60a-925a995aa4d3) - {"currentTime":"
2025-05-02T20:29:37Z
","interval":60,"status":"Accepted"}
appears charger has OCPP connectivity issue
Count of “OFFLINE” is 5969 in last 3 days
Charger send StatusNotification as Faulted on 2025-05-02 20:29:38 {""connectorId"":0,""errorCode"":""OtherError"",""status"":""Faulted"",""vendorId"":""SICHARGE D"",""vendorErrorCode"":""ChargerOperationMode""}"
Since Then it is faulted
Charger went into failsafe mode, because it was rebooted with router 2 unreachable.
2025-05-02T13:47:58.358086+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [CRS] Reboot active...power cycle to LOGO sent
Charger is now healthy, as router 2 is reachable and after reboot, failsafe mode is disappeared.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0422095 - ID0422095-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313508370032] Iplanet OCPP Offline CRM:02023000606
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena Carusone,
Greetings of the day.
We would like to inform you that Router 2 was previously unreachable, which caused the charger to enter failsafe mode and go offline. After Router 2 became accessible again, we performed a reboot, and the charger is now online on both OCPP and SCB with no active error flags.
We kindly request you to confirm by the end of today if we may proceed with closing the ticket. If we do not hear back from you, we will proceed to close the ticket tomorrow.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
